sections.heading: SSC Document Upload Rules.
body: While Staff Selection Commission (SSC) portals primarily demand JPEGs for photographs and signatures, certain post categories and selection posts require uploading supporting qualifications or experience proofs in PDF format.

The standard limit for these scanned PDF files is 500 KB. Running local browser-based compression ensures your high-resolution scanner files are reduced to this exact target size while keeping the text fully readable.

faq.q: What is the SSC PDF size limit for certificates?
faq.a: For SSC posts requiring certificate uploads, the maximum file size for PDFs is typically 500 KB.

faq.q: Which SSC exams require PDF document uploads?
faq.a: While SSC CGL and CHSL mainly request photographs and signatures in JPG, Phase/Selection Post notifications and Phase IX/X/XI/XII document verification stages require uploading experience proofs, degree marksheets, and caste certificates in PDF format up to 500 KB.

faq.q: Can I compress multi-page SSC marksheets into a single PDF under 500 KB?
faq.a: Yes. Zcompressor handles multi-page PDF documents smoothly. A 4-page scanned marksheet PDF will be compressed to ~400 KB while retaining full legibility across every page.

faq.q: What resolution should I scan my documents at for SSC portal uploads?
faq.a: We recommend scanning your original certificates at 200 DPI in color or grayscale. A 200 DPI scan offers an optimal balance between visual clarity and initial file size, making local compression to 500 KB fast and seamless.

faq.q: Is Zcompressor safe for SSC candidate certificates?
faq.a: Yes. Processing is 100% browser-based. Your documents stay inside your device, avoiding third-party server risks.
